action.objective: Verify h7g8 (Qxg8) as the strongest move by searching all Black replies at depth 4 and checking for tactical refutations.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 2 suggested h7g8 with exact score 3216, but completed depth was only 2 with cutoff, so evidence is shallow and not commit-ready. The move withdraws the queen from h7 to g8, giving check to the black king on d8, and is the reserved verification candidate. Need single-candidate depth-4 verification to confirm no forced mate or tactic against White and compare against the alternative h1g1 (3169) and e1g1 (3166).
